Transaction amounts are stored as 64-bit integers in the database (Postgres bigint), representing values exactly with no rounding errors from floating point. The amounts keep their precision exactly. Currencies like the yen, which have no cents, are handled by storing whole number amounts, so no fractional values are involved.
